assign.request: Investigate the site-wide layout problems at 900/1440/3440, find the causing rules, propose a SIMPLE page layout system (≤5 primitives) with previews and full-screen

log.msg: Step 1 done — 24 shots (8 pages x 900/1440/3440), DPR1, networkidle+2rAF. /framework/web/ 404s (App.load: nothing matches). CSS census: 85 files, 7583 lines, 366 rule blocks, 202 at-rules, 1553 declarations.

assign.now: shots in hand — naming defects, reading the causing CSS

log.msg: CAUSE FOUND for Mikes rail split: ext/AITask/ai.css:214-218 — @media (max-width:64em) gives .ai-index-rail flex:0 0 min(22em,34dvh). Measured at 900w: the rail is 306px tall holding 31838px of content, sitting above .page-catalog-pages (479/7390). Two scrollable rows, verbatim. Three competing :has() rules (ai.css:196, 215, 225) decide that one rails layout.

Complexity census: 83 :has() uses across 25 css files; 37 @media blocks with 13 DISTINCT width breakpoints (52em 64em 62rem 60em 56em 82em 40em 36em 34em 28em 26rem 700px 44em); only 5 files use @container. Every one of those @media queries measures the WINDOW while styling a box inside a region that is window minus 220-274px of sidebar (minus up to 34em more of ai rail) — so each breakpoint is wrong by 220-640px.

Measure measured, not estimated: prose lines are 622px@900 (86ch), 795px@1440 (104ch), 936px@3440 (104ch) — the em ratio makes it flat across viewports, so --measure:52em is ~104 chars everywhere. .page.full removes the ceiling not the width: the report page runs 2248px = 250 chars at 3440. Dead space at 3440: doc 53%, styles 50%, core 34%.

Five page shells in use, three documented: standard/full/fill + topic (styles.css:89) + doc-page/doc-section (Doc.css) + layout-full (layouts.css:18) + dt-page. c("page full fill flex v") is hand-typed 26 times. Prior art (layout-hunt/audit.md, styles/doc/measure.md, wall-polish) all diagnosed correctly and all end pending Mikes verdict — the site is still broken because the two site-wide decisions were never taken, not because nobody looked.

assign.outcome: **The CSS is not too big — it is too conditional, and the two decisions that would fix it were never taken.** 47 live stylesheets / 239 rules is small for 274 pages; the sprawl is 59 `:has()` across 17 files and 14 width media queries on 10 different breakpoints, every one of them measuring the WINDOW while styling a box inside a region that is window minus 220-274px of sidebar. Mikes rail bug is one declaration: `ext/AITask/ai.css:214` gives the task rail `flex: 0 0 min(22em, 34dvh)` below 64em — at 900 that is a 306px band holding 31,838px of content above a second scroller. The measure is 104 chars/line at every width above 1100 (`Page.css:70`, `--measure: 52em`), and `.page.full` makes it worse not better — the report page runs 250 chars at 3440. 53% of a 3440 screen is dead on doc pages because `--breakout` caps `.wide` at 1295 of 3165 and there is no rung between 52em and full bleed. Five page shells are in use where three are documented, and `c("page full fill flex v")` is hand-typed 26 times. Proposal: five primitives — page / rail / wall / stage / solo — each with the CSS it needs and the rules it deletes, migrated through three templates (report, Doc.css, catalog browse()) covering ~120 of ~274 page.js. Read-only run: nothing was fixed.
